name: dogfood-nats-jetstream
description: Dogfood app (v1.20-4) — a NATS JetStream + KV + Object Store + subject routing pipeline that exercises 4 patterns (JetStream persistent stream + durable consumer + ack / redelivery / KV Store put + get + watch + delete + versioning / Object Store put + get + delete + chunk metadata / subject-based routing with wildcard subject + queue group) driven by @kiwa-test/streaming NATS mock in KIWA_MODE=mock and a live nats.js client in KIWA_MODE=real (env-skip NATS_URL). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 7-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/streaming -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
